issues.description: Wrong page is being shown. The current URL is /design/step-2 but the screenshot shows Step 1 (room selection). Expected screen is step-3b: Style blend confirmation with percentage bars for top styles (e.g. 65% Scandinavian, 35% Japandi), human-readable style names, 'This feels right' confirm button, and slider adjustment option.
issues.root_cause: The current URL /design/step-2 is rendering the step-1 room selection UI instead of the step-3b style blend confirmation. Either routing is misconfigured or the wrong component is being rendered at this route.

issues.description: Hydration mismatch error in apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx. The progress bar width style differs between server ('width:5%') and client ('width:15%'), causing full hydration failure and client-side re-render. This suggests the percentage value is being calculated dynamically on mount without SSR-safe initialization.
issues.element: Progress bar div in step-3 page
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx, a progress bar's inline style `width` is computed from state or a value that differs between server and client render (server renders 5%, client renders 15%). Likely using Math.random(), Date, or reading from localStorage/sessionStorage directly during render without a mounted guard.

issues.element: Style name labels on step-3b percentage bars
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3b/page.tsx, style keys from quiz state are likely rendered directly without a display-name mapping lookup.

fixes.reason: Fixes hydration mismatch by rendering 0% width on server (matching initial server state) and only applying the real calculated width after client mount, eliminating the server/client style mismatch.
